analytics.title: Cross-platform metrics, unified.
analytics.body: Pull Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, GMB, X, and more into a single live dashboard. Drill into any post, any platform, any window — without spreadsheets.

analytics.b2: Custom date ranges with on-the-fly comparisons

composer.title: Write once. Publish everywhere.
composer.body: Compose a single post and tailor it per platform inline. Attach assets from the media library, schedule into queues, or publish immediately.

inbox.title: Every reply in one timeline.
inbox.body: Comments, DMs, mentions, reviews, and WhatsApp messages — all merged into one unified inbox with sentiment tagging and AI-suggested replies.
inbox.b2: Sentiment + intent tagging out of the box
inbox.b3: AI reply suggestions in your brand voice

ai.title: AI that knows your brand voice.
ai.body: Upload sample posts to train a private brand voice profile. Generate captions, hashtags, replies, and predictions — every output carries your tone.

automations.title: Smart automations, no code.
automations.body: Trigger actions on schedule, sentiment, or keywords. Auto-reply to FAQs, escalate negative reviews, and notify the right human at the right moment.
automations.b2: Trigger on schedule, keyword, or sentiment
automations.b3: Built-in connectors to Slack, email, WhatsApp
automations.b4: Run history with full audit trail

reports.title: Polished reports clients love.
reports.body: Generate beautiful, white-labelled performance reports in minutes. Schedule weekly or monthly delivery, share via secure links, or export to PDF.
reports.b1: Branded PDF and shareable web links

team.title: Granular collaboration controls.
team.body: Invite teammates, assign clients, scope permissions per page or action. Approval workflows keep brand integrity tight without slowing you down.

security.title: Enterprise-grade by default.

security.b2: Audit log searchable across every action

real_estate.headline: Capture and qualify property leads via WhatsApp
real_estate.body: Run click-to-WhatsApp ads, route enquiries through a bot that asks for budget and locality, then push qualified leads to your CRM. Schedule property reels and Instagram posts from the same Composer.
real_estate.b1: CTWA campaigns with platform-native lead forms
real_estate.b2: Visual bot builder for qualification flows

healthcare.headline: Cut no-shows with WhatsApp reminders + a unified inbox
healthcare.body: Send appointment reminders 24h and 2h before the slot via WhatsApp templates. Reschedule requests land in the same inbox as Instagram DMs and Google reviews — your team works from one queue.
healthcare.b2: Unified inbox across DMs, reviews, comments
healthcare.b3: Per-clinic workspaces with shared brand voice

agencies.headline: Manage many clients without losing the thread
agencies.body: A small agency can manage many client workspaces from one Bop Social tenant. Approval flows, white-label reports, and per-client brand voice mean the work scales without a proportional headcount increase.
agencies.b2: Approval flows for posts and replies

restaurants.headline: CTWA bots that take orders and bookings
restaurants.body: Run Click-to-WhatsApp ads that drop the user into a bot for menu, location, and booking. Route confirmed orders to your POS via webhook. Update Instagram and Google Business with daily specials from one Composer.
restaurants.b1: Menu + booking bots out of the box

ecommerce.headline: Catalogue ads + WhatsApp checkout
ecommerce.body: Pull products from Shopify or Woo into Composer. Run carousel ads on Instagram and Facebook with deep links into a WhatsApp catalogue checkout. Reply to inbound messages with AI-suggested replies in your brand voice.

security.hero_subtitle: Bop Social is built on the same security primitives banks and hospitals rely on. We treat your data — and your customers' data — like it's our own.

encryption.title: Encryption everywhere
encryption.body: TLS 1.3 in transit. AES-256-GCM (Fernet) at rest for OAuth tokens, API keys, and customer secrets. Keys rotated quarterly.

infrastructure.title: Hardened infrastructure
infrastructure.body: AWS multi-AZ deployments. Per-environment isolation. WAF + DDoS mitigation. Automated patching + vulnerability scans daily.

audit.title: Audit log, always-on
audit.body: Every action — auth, OAuth connect, publish, role change — is logged with actor, timestamp, IP, and result. Searchable for 1 year on Growth, custom on Enterprise.

compliance.title: Compliance-ready
compliance.body: GDPR + India DPDP compliant by design. SOC 2 Type II in progress (target Q3 2026). HIPAA, ISO 27001 on Enterprise contracts.

security.certifications_subtitle: Where we are today, and where we're headed.
security.vulnerability_body: We run a private vulnerability disclosure program with competitive rewards for verified critical issues. Email security@bopsocial.com with reproduction steps and impact assessment. We acknowledge within 24 hours and triage within 72.
